title: Spine structural-change prediction

titles: Apical and basal dendritic spine plasticity during learning, including Kir perturbation

scientific_question: Which pre-learning activity/coactivity measurements predict later spine-volume change?
primary_outputs: Predicted continuous volume change per eligible spine, with mouse/FOV provenance private.

data_manifest.file_count_scope: Top-level published assets, including code/docs where packaged together; not a participant count.

recording_contract.neural: Per-mouse/FOV/session dictionaries include spine event rates, movement/nonmovement measures, local/coincident coactivity and event-aligned spine/dendrite traces. Selected Kir dictionaries additionally include time × cell dFoF; the primary scoped task uses measured spine-level features.
recording_contract.labels: spine_volumes/followup_volumes, spine_flags/followup_flags, dendrite_ids, branch_order, positions and session define longitudinal plasticity labels; author structural_plasticity recomputes volume-change classes rather than only plotting aggregate values.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Early/Middle/Late session and followup pairs provide the feature-task temporal contract; parameters include SamplingRate/ActivityWindow for available traces. Exact seconds between every longitudinal visit and raw continuous traces are not verified, so no general forecasting-timescale claim.
recording_contract.biological_ids: mouse_id,FOV,session and dendrite_ids are documented fields. Main_Pipeline explicitly lists control apical/basal and Kir cohorts; some mouse IDs occur in both compartments. Group by mouse first, then FOV/dendrite/spine, preserving repeated measures.
recording_contract.evidence: 430 archive directory entries; ReadME, Main_Pipeline, utilities and structural_plasticity inspected by bounded ZIP ranges. Per-measurement dictionaries are inputs; no pickle deserialization or numerical analysis occurred.
